scope: Fragment for the Deepin port, for the root to merge (images, themes.deepin, rejected_recommendations); nothing central is edited here. Two photographs in the root's policy (SFW, photography, no digital-art or AI-related tag); ids disjoint from the root catalogue at 38dafed (56 images, 29 themes). Links and metadata only; no artwork is stored or redistributed. Authorship and licence are unknown and stay unknown.

query_filters.ai_art_filter: not used; every candidate's detail response was checked instead

policy.detail_filter: Reject AI-art tag 133451 and AI generator/tag names; also reject candidates tagged digital art, illustration, space art, 3D or CGI, any other desktop's or vendor's name or logo. Never equate absence of a tag with certified non-AI provenance.
policy.copyright: All images remain property of original owners. Catalogue stores links/metadata only; full artworks and provider thumbnails are not redistributed.
policy.candidates_viewed: 24 large thumbnails in two contact sheets (12 dark, 12 light); detail responses fetched for 8 (1pvd8v, ex5m3w, jxgvxy, we97wq, r2k6km, k8xdr6, 4dmlvl, vqexy5); full-resolution originals downloaded for the two selected only
policy.runtime: Recommendations are selected in the separate Wallpaper pane. Theme packages bundle no artwork and set no wallpaper.

ex5m3w.subject: A lit grid window and tiled interior wall seen at night in a near-black graphite facade (monochrome, low light, minimalist architecture)

author.verification: not independently verified; Wallhaven tag 'Jonathan Curry' and uploader account Jcurry agree, nothing else was opened
author.candidate_basis: Wallhaven tag 147722 'Jonathan Curry' on this image; no source link

ai_review.visual_assessment: photographic appearance (low-light architectural photograph: sensor grain, real light fall-off, mullion shadows); provenance is not proof of capture method; no AI-related tag, no digital-art, 3D or CGI tag
ai_review.inspected: full-resolution original, centre-fill crops at 16:9, 3440x1440 and 1080x1920 and native-pixel detail patches (centre and bottom-right corner)

full_resolution_review.assessment: usable: very quiet graphite field, one lit window as the only detail
full_resolution_review.notes: Measured on the 6016x3384 original: whole-image mean rgb(48,47,42), upper third rgb(27,27,27) (neutral graphite), lower third rgb(38,38,35). The lit window is warm sepia, not cool: it suits a graphite desktop with a quiet accent but not a glass-blue one. 16:9 and ultrawide centre-fill keep the lit grid (ultrawide trims its top); the 9:16 centre slice keeps only the left part of the window. Most of the frame is flat near-black, so desktop widgets and the dock stay legible without opaque cards. No watermark or logo seen in the corners at native size.
full_resolution_review.provenance_limit: visual photographic assessment and current provider tags only; original authorship, licence and capture method remain unverified

crop_review.algorithm: centre cover crop then resize (Version: ImageMagick 7.1.2-34 Q16-HDRI x86_64 c5d4ca8a0:20261014); JPEG q90 files hashed

16x9.result: accepted: the window, its mullions and the tiled wall stay whole; flat graphite on the left and right

ultrawide.result: accepted: the 21:9 crop of the 16:9 original trims the ceiling at the top of the window and some wall at the bottom; grid and wall remain

portrait.result: accepted with a caution: only the left part of the window survives the 9:16 centre slice; the rest is flat graphite

parent_verification.evidence: Original and all three crop hashes verified against private files; crop review sheets and native-pixel patches independently inspected by integration owner.
remaining: Original authorship, capture method and licence remain unverified; portrait architecture crop keeps only part of window, ice foreground is busy.

r2k6km.subject: Pale overcast sky over a field of white and pale-blue ice floes in a glacier lagoon (Jokulsarlon, Iceland)

author.verification: not independently verified; Wallhaven gives no author tag and no source link

ai_review.visual_assessment: photographic appearance (landscape photograph: natural cloud and ice texture, real water reflections); provenance is not proof of capture method; no AI-related tag, no digital-art, 3D or CGI tag
ai_review.inspected: full-resolution original, centre-fill crops at 16:9, 3440x1440 and 1080x1920 and native-pixel detail patches (centre and bottom-right corner)

full_resolution_review.assessment: usable with a stated caution: pale upper half, busier darker lower half
full_resolution_review.notes: Measured on the 3840x2160 original: upper third rgb(215,224,233) pale cool blue-white, whole-image mean rgb(157,175,190), lower third rgb(95,117,133) with dark water between the floes. The sky is quiet behind a top bar; the ice field is detailed, so cards over it should be opaque. 16:9 is the native aspect (no crop); ultrawide keeps the horizon and floes; the 9:16 centre slice keeps sky, mountains and a column of floes. No watermark or logo seen in the corners at native size.
full_resolution_review.provenance_limit: visual photographic assessment and current provider tags only; original authorship, licence and capture method remain unverified

crop_review.algorithm: centre cover crop then resize (Version: ImageMagick 7.1.2-34 Q16-HDRI x86_64 c5d4ca8a0:20261014); JPEG q90 files hashed

ultrawide.result: accepted: trims top sky and bottom ice; horizon, mountains and floes remain

portrait.result: accepted: sky, distant mountains and a column of floes in the centre slice

parent_verification.evidence: Original and all three crop hashes verified against private files; crop review sheets and native-pixel patches independently inspected by integration owner.
remaining: Original authorship, capture method and licence remain unverified; portrait architecture crop keeps only part of window, ice foreground is busy.

deepin.rationale: Graphite and pale blue-white photography in place of Deepin's blue-silk and smoked-glass renders (the latter are CGI, rejected by the root policy).

dark.rationale: Near-neutral graphite (upper third rgb 27,27,27) with one lit window: matches the #252525 / #101010 dark surfaces; warm light is the only colour.

light.rationale: Pale cool blue-white sky and ice (upper third rgb 215,224,233) near the light window colour #f8f8f8 with a blue tint; the accent #0081ff stays legible.

deepin.placement: Centre-fill. Dark: keep the lit window in the middle third; the rest is flat graphite. Light: the sky occupies the top third, so a top bar sits on pale blue; the lower half is busy ice, so cards or a dock over it should be opaque.
deepin.crop_policy: keep original aspect; centre-fill crops on aspect mismatch; 16:9, 3440x1440 and 1080x1920 centre crops were reviewed (see crop_review)

full_resolution_audit.method: curl of each detail response (sha256 of the raw bytes), of the large thumbnail and of the original; sha256sum; ImageMagick centre cover crops (-resize WxH^ -gravity center -extent WxH, -quality 90) at 1920x1080, 3440x1440, 1080x1920; native-pixel patches (1000x560 centre, 900x300 bottom-right) inspected by eye; mean colours from 1x1 resizes of the whole image and its top and bottom thirds
full_resolution_audit.private_evidence: /var/tmp/decebal-deepin/wh/{full,crops,detail,th,detail-check.png,review-*.png,SHA256SUMS} (originals and crops are not committed; SHA256SUMS lists every file and equals the hashes in this fragment)
full_resolution_audit.unverified: No licence/copyright/capture-method guarantee; no full photo or derivative committed; physical compositor readability not checked; ultrawide and portrait were reviewed as crops, not on a display
